recipe.title: Push an app page into Figma

steps.do: Load as prereq before any Figma MCP call
Translate the code page into a Figma frame using your design system

recipe.useWhen: You already built the page in code and want a Figma version without recreating it by hand.

name: BUILD / REVIEW / A11Y
tagline: Ship UI with taste, UX, and accessibility

recipe.title: Build a new page, end to end

steps.do: Build the UI with taste — avoid the generic AI look
Audit UX, typography, focus states, touch targets

recipe.useWhen: Shipping any user-facing page or component.

recipe.title: Write copy + prompts that actually work

steps.do: Anchor copy / pricing / CTAs in real behavioral principles
Refactor the AI-powered features behind that copy into structured, evaluated prompts

recipe.useWhen: Building or rewriting landing pages, pricing pages, onboarding flows, or AI features.

recipe.title: Start a project with real tokens, not blank canvas

steps.do: Point it at a reference site — your own, a competitor, or one you admire — to extract color, typography, and spacing tokens

recipe.useWhen: Starting a new project or rebrand.

recipe.title: Don't reinvent — search first, then forge

steps.do: Check if a skill already exists for what you need
If you're on Cursor: package your workflow as a SKILL.md
If you're on Codex CLI: same idea, with scaffolding scripts
If you're on Claude Code or sharing the skill: most thorough variant, includes testing and verification

recipe.useWhen: You catch yourself repeating the same workflow more than twice.
